name: A New Ore Sample
summary: Tatternack Steelforge seeks new ore in Thousand Needles to strengthen the Horde’s arms. The blacksmith in Camp Taurajo sends you south to bring back a sample for testing.

sections.title: A Smith's Ambition
sections.body: Tatternack Steelforge works as a blacksmith in Camp Taurajo, under Orgrimmar’s direct scrutiny. He has already supplied weapons made from local centaur armaments, but still wants to prove his craft to Warchief Thrall. Travelers passing through showed him a strange piece of ore taken from a kobold to the south. When they refused to sell it, Tatternack took their refusal as an insult to his craft and the Horde.

sections.title: Venture into Thousand Needles
sections.body: You leave the flat plains of the southern Barrens for the towering canyon mazes of Thousand Needles. Kobold diggers tunnel through its crags and cliffs. Bring back unrefined chunks taken directly from them, and Tatternack can judge whether the raw mineral can be forged into weapons worthy of Thrall’s war effort.

faq.answer: Tatternack Steelforge is an orc weaponsmith stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He crafts weapons for the Horde’s frontier defense and seeks new materials to impress Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: Where does this ore sample come from?
faq.answer: Kobolds carry the unrefined ore through the winding canyons of Thousand Needles, south of the Great Lift at the Barrens’ border.

faq.q: Why is Tatternack angry at the passing travelers?
faq.answer: Travelers from the south showed Tatternack a strange mineral chunk taken from a slain kobold, then refused to sell it. He saw their hoarding of vital materials as an unpatriotic insult to the Warchief and cursed them as cowards.

faq.q: What will Tatternack do with the ore?
faq.answer: Tatternack plans to analyze the ore’s metallurgical properties and test its strength. If it proves durable enough, he intends to forge a prototype weapon and present it directly to Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before this task?
faq.answer: First, you complete Weapons of Choice by gathering specific weapons from the various centaur tribes threatening Camp Taurajo, proving that local armaments can be repurposed.

faq.q: Why are kobolds in Thousand Needles carrying this ore?
faq.answer: Kobolds compulsively burrow and mine, tunneling through crags and subterranean veins. In Thousand Needles, their digging has uncovered unusual deposits that surface-dwellers have rarely touched.

angles.text: As a Horde smith, you help secure new metal deposits to keep the frontier armed against surrounding threats.
At Camp Taurajo, you can contribute materials to the Warchief’s military preparations from the Horde’s southern bastion.
As a prospector, you know the value of raw, unrefined veins unearthed by burrowing creatures in unexplored southern canyons.
